nodes.statement: The frozen provider declaration has the exact Erdos 1004 solved-variant type.

nodes.statement: There exists c > 0 such that eventually every distinct-totient run beginning at n has real length K bounded by n / exp(c (log n)^(1/3)).

trust_boundary: Provider sorryAx and missing canonical provider import are explicit; no local axiom, unsafe declaration, opaque oracle, sorry, or admit is introduced.
